Project.node_description: An experiment or set of experiments belonging to different batches within a research group.

Experiment.node_description: A set of runs within the same batch and/or project.

node_attributes.name: Experiment name
node_attributes.cultivation_type: Types in ascending order: Screen(Prior Screening before fermentation process), S1(Small Scale Screening: Batch Operation Mode), S2(Small Scale Screening: Fed-Batch Mode), PD(Process Development), Fermentation(Final Stage: process development finished)
node_attributes.cultivation_id: Cultivation ID: 3 digits coming from experiment name, in the format DDB_PD_XXX (Project_cultivation-type_cultivation-id).

Run.node_description: A run is the individual bioprocess experiment running in a bioreactor.

node_attributes.name: Run name
node_attributes.is_control: Boolean variable referencing if a run is a control, 'YES' or 'NO'
node_attributes.replicate_number: Replicate run number. Number 1 means only 1 replicate.  Number 2 means a replicate from the previous run (previous culitivation_id run) E.j.: A run (name:DDB_PD_023_AMBR) with replicate_number = 2, is a replicate from the previous run (name:DDB_PD_022_AMBR) with replicate_number = 1.

Bioreactor.node_description: Concrete type of bioreactor environment where the fermentation occurs.

node_attributes.name: Container type implemented, such as Ambr250.
node_attributes.brand: The bioreactor type brand-specific, such as Sartorius: Ambr, Eppendorf: DASGIP, and Getinge: Applikon.
node_attributes.unit: The unit of the working volume, such as L, mL, m3.
node_attributes.operational_mode: Different types of functional configurations of the bioreactor defining types of fermentations or cultivations, including batch, fed-batch and continuous (which could be chemostat or turbidostat).

Strain.node_description: A distinct microbial strain within the database.

node_attributes.id: Strain ID, related to benchling software
node_attributes.name: Strain name
node_attributes.parent: A genetically modified derivative of the host strain that serves as the starting point for further modifications.
node_attributes.host: A well-characterized microbial strain, with and ID linked to NCBI taxonomy database, used as the baselibe for genetic manipulation or protein expression.
node_attributes.genotype: The genetic profile of a strain
node_attributes.genotype_change: The genetic modification in the strain genotype

Taxa.node_description: A specific taxa within the database, such as species, genus, family, order, class, phylum, kingdom, domain.

node_attributes.id: Taxonomic ID: unique identifier assigned by the NCBI to the source organism where the strain belong to.
node_attributes.name: Organism name

Medium.node_description: A solution containing macronutrients, micronutrients and buffering agents.

node_attributes.id: Medium ID, unique identifier from source software
node_attributes.name: Medium name containing project name, medium_type and medium number e.j.: DDB_BM_001
node_attributes.type: Medium type: BM, FM and SM. Batch Medium(BM): Medium used for the batch process in a batch or fed-batch fermentation; Feed Medium(FM): Medium used for fed-batch fermentation or for chemostat fermentation, normally initiated after the end of batch fermentation; Seed Medium(SM): Medium used for the seed culture or pre-cultures.

Cultivation_cond.node_description: Initial experimental parameters and environmental conditions set prior to or at the sart of an experiment or Run. These cultivation conditions, categorical or scalar variables, include environmental setpoints such as pH, temperature(ºC), initial volume, and optical density (OD) of the seed cutlure.

node_attributes.name: Variable name
node_attributes.type: Node subtype category for cultivation condition variables. Types: temperature, pH, DO, biomass(initial OD or inoculum OD), cultivation volume, culture and seed.

Process_var.node_description: Technical parameters measured, depending on the bioreactor, during the bioprocess (online measurements) or after the bioprocess (offline measurements). Process varibles are timeseries variables and are used to control initial parameters from cultivation conditions node type.

node_attributes.name: Variable name
node_attributes.type: Node subtype category for process variables. Types: temperature, pH, do, biomass, feed, sample, pressure, cultivation volume, compound, respiratory_metrics,
node_attributes.analysis_method: Method used to obtain the data: INLINE, ONLINE, ATLINE, OFFLINE, NON_APPLICABLE. INLINE: analyzer is integrated into the bioreactor and the measurement is taken continuosly into the bioreactor. The sample flows continuously through the analyzer. The measurament is real-time with high frequency data, enabling real-time process monitoring and control; ONLINE: extract representative sample from the bioreactor and introduce it into the measurement zone. Sample can either be discarded or returned to the bioreactor; ATLINE: extract a sample from the process line and transporte it to a nerby analyzer. There is delay between sampling and measurment; OFFLINE: collect a sample from the process line and transport it to the analyzis laboratory. The sample is not returned to the process line; NON_APPLICABLE: No analysis method is needed.

Compound.node_description: A compound is an offline data measured by other instruments (such as HPLC). Compund node type groups: substrate, product, by-product and chemical elements.

node_attributes.name: Compound variable name
node_attributes.type: Node subtype category for compound. Types: output_var, input_var
node_attributes.analysis_method: Method used to obtain the data. OFFLINE: collect a sample from the process line and transport it to the analyzis laboratory. The sample is not returned to the process line; NON_APPLICABLE: No analysis method is needed.

Calculated_var.node_description: Calculated variables inclues intermediate results and final results, both of them calculated implementing bioprocess data: initial parameters from cultivation conditions (initial parameters) and process variables (online and offline measurements).

node_attributes.name: Calculated variable name
node_attributes.type: Node subtype category for a calculated variable. Subtypes: respiratory_metrics, volume, carbon_energy_source, input_var(substrate+Oxygen), output_var(products and by-products), biomass.
node_attributes.source: Method implemented to calculate the variable.  Computed by the bioreactor software: Ambr, Lucullus, TOM, Robolector, or by PAS-X(synonym of inCyght) or fermentdb_calculator(the built-in calculator tool in FermentDB).
node_attributes.is_result: Boolean attribute for calculated result. True when final result and False when the variable is an intermediate result. Intermediate results are variables that will be implemented to calculate final results
node_attributes.performance_variable: Variables evaluating process efficiency. Type of performance variable: yield, rate, respiratory_metrics(RQ) and non_applicable(not classified as performance variable)

iModulon.node_description: An iModulon is an independently modulated group of genes, often representing the effect of a transcriptional regulator. For an iModulon, acivity values can be caluclated allowing to quantitatively estimate the activity of the gene set contained. Ref: ref: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-019-13483-w

node_attributes.name: iModulon name
node_attributes.regulator_readable: Transcriptional regulator that is associated with the iModulon
node_attributes.n_genes: Number of genes in the iModulon
node_attributes.exp_var: Explained variance value for the iModulon
node_attributes.category_num: The number of the belonging category in the iModulon

Country.node_description: Country where the project takes place.

Institution.node_description: Institution where the project takes place.

Event.node_description: Fermentation event that triggers the fermentation phase to start or end.
